review.why: Turns papers, articles and reports into structured briefs, compares sources and extracts citations in five styles.
review.summary: Three workflows for documents the user already has: a single-source summary picked by source type (paper, article, report, documentation), a multi-source comparison matrix with consensus, contested points and gaps, and citation extraction formatted in APA, IEEE, Chicago, Harvard or MLA. Adds a four-dimension source quality rating and a verification checklist.
strengths: Verification loop: every finding anchored to a location, missing metadata marked, never invented
Source quality rated on credibility, evidence, recency and objectivity
States clearly that it digests supplied documents and does not search
cautions: Does not find sources: discovery is left to other skills
Citation extraction relies on regular expressions and misses some formats
The two scripts and two reference files are described, not read here
